# HAMS — Wialon Unit Provisioning Checklist (per unit)

**Date:** 2026-06-12
**Owner of this step:** Platform vendor (Wialon admin) — Direction 2, Option A.
**Applies to:** every HAMS app unit, before the device is handed out.

> **Why this exists:** a unit missing the Advanced-tab filters will return
> `#AD#1` (looks successful) but **silently store nothing** (failure F7). At
> fleet scale this is silent, batch-wide data loss. This checklist is a
> hard handover gate: a unit is not "ready" until every row below is ticked
> and verified.

---

## A. Per-unit settings (apply to EVERY unit)

### A1 — General tab
- [ ] Hardware type = **Wialon IPS** (ID `600002235`)
- [ ] Unique ID set (e.g. `OC154_H001`) — must match the ID issued to the device
- [ ] Password = **blank** (the app logs in with `;NA`; any password breaks login)

### A2 — Advanced tab (CRITICAL — F7)
- [ ] Average speed between messages = **0**
- [ ] Distance between coordinates = **0**
- [ ] Message validity filtration = **Off**

> ⚠️ Any non-zero speed/distance value causes Wialon to drop every message.
> This is the single most important section.

### A3 — Sensors tab
- [ ] `FFB_CUT` — Custom, parameter **`ffb_cut`**
- [ ] `battery_pct` — Custom, parameter **`battery`**, units `%`
- [ ] *(optional)* `work_count` — Counter, parameter **`work_count`**
- [ ] *(optional)* `event_code` — Custom, parameter **`event_code`**, calibration 179 / 180 / 35 only

### A4 — Reporting / notifications (account-level, not per unit)
- [ ] Unit added to the V6 report template scope (`HAMS_FFB_Cut_Count_V6`, filter `ffb_cut=1`)
- [ ] During testing: unit kept OUT of production notification scopes (179/180) until deliberate cutover

---

## B. Verification (per unit — proves it actually stores)

A unit is only "ready" after a real message is confirmed stored:

- [ ] Trigger one test message to this unit's `unique_id` (app `+` press, or a test frame)
- [ ] Confirm it appears on `pro.navi-agnostics.com` for this unit (not just `#AD#1` at the app)
- [ ] Confirm the `p` block carries `ffb_cut`, `battery`, `event_code`, `work_count`
- [ ] Confirm the sensor(s) decode the value

> Acks alone are NOT proof. F7 returns `#AD#1` while dropping the message —
> only seeing the stored message in the Web UI confirms the filters are right.

---

## C. Batch sign-off

Fill one row per unit. A batch is handed to the app/provisioning side only
when every unit in it is verified. The verified `unique_id`s are what get
imported into the n8n claim table (Direction 2, D5).

| # | Unit name | Unique ID | A1–A3 set | Verified stored (B) | Configured by | Date |
|---|-----------|-----------|:---------:|:-------------------:|---------------|------|

| 2 |           |           |  ☐        |  ☐                  |               |      |
| 3 |           |           |  ☐        |  ☐                  |               |      |
| … |           |           |  ☐        |  ☐                  |               |      |

---

## D. Handover to provisioning (Direction 2)

- [ ] Add each **verified** unit to the designated **"HAMS-ready" unit group** in Wialon — n8n seeds only from this group, so unverified units never enter the claim pool
- [ ] n8n seeding workflow pulls the group → Postgres claim table (UPSERT, `claimed = false`)
- [ ] New devices then auto-claim these units on first launch (no further unit work)

---

## Notes
- This checklist is the operational form of `CONTEXT.md §5` and
  `docs/vendor/HAMS_INTEGRATION_REFERENCE.md §4–§5`; those remain authoritative for
  exact values.
- App-side `event_code` policy is fixed: only `179`, productive `180`, `35`
  ever reach Wialon. Do not add HAMS-local codes to sensors/notifications.
- Per-unit IPS passwords (hardening, CONTEXT.md "D-future") are out of scope
  for this checklist while the app logs in with `;NA`.
